column1: # ZAP False-Positive Suppression Rules for directly.social
# Next.js aggressively caches static assets with Vercel/CDN headers — not a vuln.
# Next.js injects build IDs and metadata comments in HTML. Not sensitive.
# Next.js build timestamps in chunks are not exploitable.
# Server Leaks Version Information via "X-Powered-By" Header
# We'll handle this in next.config.ts (poweredByHeader: false). Suppress until fixed.
# Staging uses HTTP in CI runner context — staging cookies are intentionally non-secure.
# NextAuth explicitly sets SameSite=lax — false positive from ZAP parser.
# Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
# CSP is set via next.config.ts headers. Warn only — not a hard fail.
# MUI emotion bundles include inline styles. Not a vulnerability.
